lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Columns of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in vertical rows posterior to the gill slits, containing approximately 4-6 nodes per column forming a semi-regular grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs to create a series of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadows on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Multiple high-luminance blobs are visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, arranged in a non-uniform distribution across its surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several remoras (commensal fish) attached to the ventral surface near the pectoral fin; high-density micro-spotting pattern on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin.
